preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in b)
preconditions.description: The input string b consists only of characters '0' and '1'.
The length of the input string b is between 1 and 100 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(b) - 2) if b[i] == '0' and b[i+1] == '1' and b[i+2] == '0')
postconditions.description: The returned value is equal to the number of non-overlapping occurrences of the substring '010' in b, where each occurrence requires exactly one flip to eliminate it.
